attempts.summary: Configured /swapfile as an exact 512 MiB, root-owned mode-0600 swap file. It is active immediately, persisted in /etc/fstab, and automatically recovered after node1 rebooted. Boot ID changed from bdbfa15c-cfc4-4b36-8edd-d0a49076e9c5 to d3c6ff37-d2e9-4060-8cf0-e506be6193e6; the system returned to running with no failed units.
